question.problem: Let $P=\{{y}_{0},{y}_{1},…,{y}_{n}\}$ be a partition of the interval $[-8,-1].$ If $Δ{y}_{j}={y}_{j}-{y}_{j-1},$ calculate ${\sum }_{j=1}^{n}6Δ{y}_{j}.$
question.worked_solution:
First, we take the factor $6$ outside the summation:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}6Δ{y}_{j}=6{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}Δ{y}_{j}\end{aligned}
$$

Note that ${\sum }_{j=1}^{n}Δ{y}_{j}$ is just the length of the interval $[-8,-1],$ because

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}Δ{y}_{j} & =({y}_{1}-{y}_{0})+({y}_{2}-{y}_{1})+({y}_{3}-{y}_{2})+⋯+({y}_{n}-{y}_{n-1}) \\  & =(\cancel{{y}_{1}}-{y}_{0})+(\cancel{{y}_{2}}-\cancel{{y}_{1}})+(\cancel{{y}_{3}}-\cancel{{y}_{2}})+⋯+({y}_{n}-\cancel{{y}_{n-1}}) \\  & =-{y}_{0}+{y}_{n} \\  & ={y}_{n}-{y}_{0} \\  & =(-1)-(-8) \\  & =8-1 \\  & =7.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
6{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}Δ{y}_{j}=6\cdot 7=42.
$$
